summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Perlae Atelier Iteration 3 (Artisane pages A/B, VersionSwitch, Footer with newsletter, Navbar Commander CTA, Home regression). All requested testids present and working. No React console errors on /, /artisane, /artisane-2, /boutique, /produit/sac-lune-nacre.
critical_code_review_comments: ArtisanHeroV2: p = products[idx % (products.length || 1)] is fine but when products is empty, prev/next handlers do (i-1+0)%0 which is NaN; harmless because buttons are only rendered when p exists, but consider disabling if products.length<=1.
Footer newsletter form: consider client-side email validation feedback beyond required attribute; currently relies on api throwing to show error toast.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 3 checks passed: artisan-hero + artisan-cutout (naturalWidth 835), version-switch A active + B navigates, ArtisanBody artisan-portrait + 8-image atelier-gallery + artisan-cta-contact render, artisan-hero-v2 + artisan-v2-photo (nw 848) + product-card cycling via artisan-v2-next (Le Sac Lune Nacre -> Le Sac Nacre Classique), shop-now href /produit/sac-nacre-classique, cta-boutique -> /boutique. Footer: cta-boutique link OK, whatsapp href contains wa.me, newsletter submit shows success toast, footer-link-boutique-sacs -> /boutique. Navbar nav-cta-button -> /boutique, cart-drawer-toggle opens drawer. Home: hero-section, hero-mini-cards, process-section, testimonials-section present; 5 product-card-* cards; atelier-3d-section canvas mounts on scroll. Zero console errors across all pages tested.
